$comment: Asset-contract example for specs/webgpu-skinned-crowd.md. The runtime reads ONLY a kit.json like this, so commissioned art can iterate without code changes. The VAT bake (bake/vat.mjs) consumes the skeletons + clips; the renderer reads archetypes + factionMask + the baked texture metadata. Values here are placeholders to pin the SHAPE, not final art.

human.source: TBD (Mixamo rig as the M1 stand-in)

$frameMap.$comment: Maps the sim per-soldier `frames` enum (web/src/battle/scene.ts) to a clip. The crowd state machine reuses this; phase is a function of sim state, not wall-clock (frozen-deterministic).

archetypes.$comment: One entry per CLASS_LOOK class id (web/src/shared/soldierModel.ts). Each picks modular pieces + a material set; mounted classes (6,7) also reference the horse skeleton.

materials.$comment: PBR set per material; factionMask channel marks texels that take the faction accent colour (mix(albedo, factionColor, mask)). Accent-only, NOT whole-body — same design as the current livery.

vat.$comment: Output of `npm run bake:anim` (to be written): RGBA32F texture, width = total frames across clips, height = bones*4, column-major mat4 packed as 4 rows. See bake/vat.mjs for the layout the skinning shader must mirror.
